\subsection*{Is the array's echo canceller being fed?}
Log sweep, normalized cross-correlation with lag search; correlation floor (no playback) ncc 0.021.

\begin{center}\footnotesize
\begin{tabular}{llllll}
\toprule
condition & channel & peak ncc & lag ms & tail ratio & rms \\
\midrule
control\_no\_playback & 0 & 0.018 & 321.44 & 0.238 & 0.06037 \\
control\_no\_playback & 1 & 0.021 & 79.50 & 0.220 & 0.02352 \\
jieli\_usb\_speaker & 0 & 0.320 & 38.88 & 0.042 & 0.21131 \\
jieli\_usb\_speaker & 1 & 0.326 & 38.88 & 0.025 & 0.65942 \\
xvf3800\_own\_output & 0 & 0.034 & 31.69 & 0.269 & 0.00109 \\
xvf3800\_own\_output & 1 & 0.061 & 86.81 & 0.200 & 0.03388 \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{center}
jieli\_usb\_speaker: strongest on ch1 (ncc 0.326, lag 38.88 ms, acoustic path); ch0 lower by 1.0x

xvf3800\_own\_output: probe not detected on either channel (floor 0.021)

The array-output condition transduced no sound (nothing is connected to the 3.5 mm jack), so its null result is no evidence either way; see results/NOTES.md.
